description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding between Seychelles and Sri Lanka for the Development of Sports
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2014-09-18
decision_details_body: - Cabinet approval was granted for signing of  above Memorandum of Understanding between the two countries for the development of sports as proposed by Hon. Mahindananda Aluthgamage, Minister of Sports.
